discussion_comments.comment_body: vLLM's `/v1/models` reports the window as `max_model_len` (it's on its ModelCard), so a vLLM source still falls back to 128K even though the comment at the top lists vLLM. Worth adding `entry.max_model_len` here?

Fixed in 2c1a7f7d7: normalization now recurses into `items` (object and tuple forms) and into `anyOf`/`oneOf`/`allOf` branches before the object-likeness gate, so nested uppercase types lowercase at every depth. Covered by the new "normalizes nested array items and combinator branches" test.

Real, thanks. Both call sites already built a context for the adjacent `composeAiSdkProviderOptions` call, so it is now hoisted into a variable and passed to `resolvePortableReasoning` as well. Worth noting they would have thrown rather than mis-typed if a bedrock request ever reached them; they only passed because the short-circuit on providerId ran first.
is this pattern present elsewhere in the codebase? seems like special handling for bedrock which I'd like to avoid if possible
what do you think about making a pr upstream to the ai-sdk itself to fix the bedrock adapter so that it doesn't accidentally send reasoning. seems like the better place for the fix to live

discussion_comments.comment_body: Good catch. This is about the shape of the usage object, not the installed AI SDK version: if a finish part still reaches normalizeUsage with reasoning under outputTokens.reasoning and no raw provider metadata, our current path misses it and leaves those tokens in outputTokens. I’ll add support for that nested field and a positive-reasoning regression test.
